scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & wait'
scripts.dev:api: bash -c 'if [[ -f .env ]]; then set -a; source .env; set +a; fi; PORT="${API_PORT:-3001}" npm run dev --workspace @seferbiz/api'
scripts.dev:web: bash -c 'if [[ -f .env ]]; then set -a; source .env; set +a; fi; PORT="${WEB_PORT:-3000}" npm run dev --workspace @seferbiz/web'
scripts.dev:stripe: bash -c 'set -a; source build.env; set +a; exec stripe listen --skip-verify --events checkout.session.completed,checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded,checkout.session.async_payment_failed --forward-to "https://${API_DOMAIN}:${HTTPS_PORT}/v1/stripe/webhook"'
